environment: Recovery design against current LIVE inventory; no production mutation

facts: Supabase does not export the private material of a platform signing key after creation.
A database restore includes auth.users but not the running Auth service configuration or JWT key material.
A self-hosted recovery with new JWT keys requires existing users to re-authenticate.

recoveryDesignImplication: Do not claim escrow of the current ES256 private key from Supabase. Unless a separately retained original key is proven, rehearse isolated Auth startup with a new recovery key, preserved user rows and tenant boundaries, explicitly invalidated old sessions, and a fresh signed-in login before controlled provider resumption.
notYetProven: Isolated Auth service startup against the independently restored production database
Fresh signed-in user journey and tenant isolation against that service
Runtime secret recovery and controlled capture resumption
Business acceptance of forced re-authentication in disaster recovery
